description: KNaNbOF₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to one O and seven F atoms. The K-O bond length is 2.88 Å. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 2.69-2.90 Å. Na is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form NaOF₅ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NbOF₅ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one NbOF₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-42°. The Na-O bond length is 2.37 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.48 Å. Nb is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form NbOF₅ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaOF₅ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaOF₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-42°. The Nb-O bond length is 1.78 Å. There are a spread of Nb-F bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.17 Å. O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, and one Nb atom. There are five inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to two equivalent K, one Na, and one Nb atom to form corner-sharing FK₂NaNb tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one Nb atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, and one Nb atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, and one Nb atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, and one Nb atom.
